title_en: The Stance of Salafism and Wahhabism Towards Ahl al-Sunnah wal-Jama'ah
description_en: The stance of Salafism and Wahhabism towards Ahl al-Sunnah wal-Jama'ah, excerpts from the program Debates in Creed by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari (may his shadow endure).
summary: This clip examines the ideological divergences between Salafi/Wahhabi movements and mainstream Ahl al-Sunnah wal-Jama'ah.
